## Summary

What user problem does this solve? What changed, and what is deliberately out of scope?

## Interfaces and behavior

- Public commands/config/schema/ABI changes:
- Permissions and side effects:
- Compatibility or migration:
- Documentation/examples updated:

## Verification

List exact executed commands and observed results. Do not claim full-suite success
from targeted tests. Include screenshots for desktop/mobile UI changes.

- [ ] Regression fails before the fix and passes after it
- [ ] Relevant unit / Rust tests
- [ ] Relevant browser tests, with browser names
- [ ] Cancellation, failure, size-limit and permission-denial cases
- [ ] Known failures or unverified platforms explicitly listed

## Security and release hygiene

- [ ] No API keys, SSH material, private endpoints, conversations or local configs
- [ ] No browser profiles, build caches, node_modules, temporary/design-process files
- [ ] Third-party copyright and license notices preserved
- [ ] New plugin permissions are minimal and documented
- [ ] No automatic retry of uncertain side effects

## Known gaps / follow-up

State remaining limitations instead of marking them as implemented.
